preamble.detail: Welcome to the PilotFish demo: EDI 276/277 Claim Status. Ingest X12 276 claim status requests, look up a demo catalog by trace number (no SQL), stage a ClaimStatusDecision, then emit an X12 277 response and file buckets (found / not-found / error). PilotFish supports the whole flow out of the box.
